style.prompt: A realistic continuous tracking shot of the exact pale metallic ice-blue and dark carbon-fiber Bugatti concept car shown in @car driving steadily along a traffic lane across the Golden Gate Bridge shown in @bridge. Preserve the car's distinctive low body, horseshoe grille, narrow headlights, sculpted side panels and wheels. Match the bridge's International Orange suspension towers, cables, roadway and sunny clear blue sky from @bridge. Camera tracks smoothly alongside at a front three-quarter angle, keeping the whole car visible while the bridge structure passes naturally behind it. Realistic rotating wheels, natural daylight and reflections, believable road contact and forward motion. The car is on the roadway, not the sidewalk. One uninterrupted shot. Silent video.
